comment.zh-TW: 主因是颱風帶來的強風／側風。中央氣象署陸上颱風警報生效，花蓮在警戒區，10/23 02–20 時三格依官方為高；歐洲模式 10/23 08–14 時陣風 69.9 節、14–20 時側風 44.4 節，陣風超過 49 節的機率 92%，但美國模式陣風僅 16.4–17.5 節，模式分歧。10/25 起美國模式能見度 32 公尺，只有一個模式提供，濃霧僅列中。整體判高。

comment.zh-CN: 主因是台风带来的强风／侧风。中央气象署陆上台风警报生效，花莲在警戒区，10/23 02–20 时三个时段依官方为高；欧洲模式 10/23 08–14 时阵风 69.9 节、14–20 时侧风 44.4 节，阵风超过 49 节的概率 92%，但美国模式阵风仅 16.4–17.5 节，模式分歧。10/25 起美国模式能见度 32 米，只有一个模式提供，浓雾仅列中。整体判高。
comment.en: The main cause is typhoon-driven strong wind and crosswind. The Central Weather Administration's land typhoon warning is in effect with Hualien in the warning area, so the three periods from 10/23 02:00 to 20:00 are High based on the official warning. The European model shows gusts of 69.9 kt on 10/23 08:00-14:00 and crosswind of 44.4 kt on 14:00-20:00, with a 92% chance of gusts over 49 kt, but the US model shows gusts of only 16.4-17.5 kt, so the models disagree. From 10/25 the US model shows visibility 32 m, but only one model provides this, so fog is rated only Medium. Overall disruption risk: High.

comment.zh-TW: 停飛風險為高，主因是強風／側風與大雨／雷雨。中央氣象署已對花蓮發布陸上颱風警報（薔琵颱風）及陸上強風特報。10/23 02–20 時受警報影響風險為高；期間歐洲系集陣風超過 49 節的機率達 92%，歐洲模式在 08–14 時預報陣風 69.9 節、6 小時雨量 70.4 毫米，14–20 時側風達 44.4 節，美國模式僅 16.4 至 17.5 節。10/24 08 時起風險轉低。
comment.zh-HK: 停飛風險為高，主因是強風／側風與大雨／雷雨。中央氣象署已對花蓮發布陸上颱風警告（薔琵颱風）及陸上強風特報。10/23 02–20 時受警告影響風險為高；期間歐洲系集陣風超過 49 節的機率達 92%，歐洲模式在 08–14 時預報陣風 69.9 節、6 小時雨量 70.4 毫米，14–20 時側風達 44.4 節，美國模式僅 16.4 至 17.5 節。10/24 08 時起風險轉低。
comment.zh-CN: 停飞风险为高，主因是强风／侧风与大雨／雷雨。中央气象署已对花莲发布陆上台风警报（蔷琵台风）及陆上强风特报。10/23 02–20 时受警报影响风险为高；期间欧洲系集阵风超过 49 节的概率达 92%，欧洲模式在 08–14 时预报阵风 69.9 节、6 小时雨量 70.4 毫米，14–20 时侧风达 44.4 节，美国模式仅 16.4 至 17.5 节。10/24 08 时起风险转低。
comment.en: Disruption risk is High, mainly due to strong winds/crosswinds and heavy rain/thunderstorms. The Central Weather Administration has issued a land typhoon warning (Typhoon Champi) and a strong wind advisory for Hualien. From 10/23 02:00 to 20:00 local, the risk is High under the warnings; the European ensemble shows a 92% chance of gusts over 49 kt, and the European model forecasts gusts of 69.9 kt with 70.4 mm of rain in 6 hours during 08:00–14:00, and crosswinds of 44.4 kt during 14:00–20:00, while the US model shows only 16.4 to 17.5 kt. Risk drops to Low from 10/24 08:00.

comment.en: Strong winds and crosswinds are the main disruption risk. With Taitung under a land typhoon warning, official sources rate 10/23 02:00–20:00 as High risk; the airport forecast (TAF) for 10/23 02:00–08:00 shows gusts of 30 kt and crosswind of 25.7 kt. During 10/23 14:00–10/24 02:00, although most models say Low, the European model forecasts gusts of 55.4 to 65.6 kt and crosswinds of 50.2 to 65 kt, the European ensemble shows a 70% to 87% chance of gusts over 49 kt, and the Japanese model shows crosswinds of 36.9 to 37.7 kt, keeping the overall disruption risk High.

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風，颱風警報生效中。機場觀測（METAR）已見平均風 35 節、陣風 48 節；機場預報（TAF）10/23 全天平均風 40 節、陣風 60 節，8 個模式全數認為高，陣風超過 49 節的機率 100%，歐洲模式 10/23 14–20 時側風達 43.1 節。10/24 08 時後轉低，但 10/27 起多數模式陣風回升到 37–47 節，停飛風險為中。

comment.en: Strong wind is the main cause, with a typhoon warning in effect. The airport observation (METAR) already shows a 35 kt mean wind gusting 48 kt; the airport forecast (TAF) has a 40 kt mean wind and 60 kt gusts all day on 10/23, all 8 models say High, there is a 100% chance of gusts over 49 kt, and the European model puts the crosswind at 43.1 kt on 10/23 14:00–20:00. Risk drops to Low after 10/24 08:00, but from 10/27 most models bring gusts back up to 37–47 kt, a Medium disruption risk.

comment.zh-CN: 强风与侧风是未来五天最主要的停飞风险。受蔷琵台风陆上台风警报影响，10/23 02 时至 10/24 02 时停飞风险为高：机场预报（TAF）平均风达 40 节、阵风 60 节，八个模式全数评为高；欧洲模式于 10/23 08–20 时预报阵风最高 77.2 节、侧风达 43.1 节，阵风超过 49 节的概率达 100%。10/24 02–08 时及 10/27 08 时至 10/28 02 时停飞风险则为中。
comment.en: Strong winds and crosswind are the main disruption risk over the next five days. Under the land typhoon warning for Typhoon Champi, disruption risk is High from 10/23 02:00 to 10/24 02:00: the airport forecast (TAF) shows mean wind of 40 kt and gusts of 60 kt, with all eight models rating it High; the European model forecasts peak gusts of 77.2 kt and crosswind up to 43.1 kt during 10/23 08:00–20:00, with a 100% chance of gusts over 49 kt. Disruption risk is Medium during 10/24 02:00–08:00 and from 10/27 08:00 to 10/28 02:00.

comment.zh-TW: 主因是強風／側風。宮古目前機場觀測（METAR）已有陣風 35 節、側風 31 節，並有暴風警報；10/23 09–21 時歐洲模式陣風 56.7–59 節、美國模式 70.8 節，側風最高 70.3 節，八個模式中八個認為高，陣風超過 49 節的機率 100%。強風延續到 10/24 15–21 時，10/24 21 時後降為低。整體停飛風險判高。

comment.en: The main cause is strong wind/crosswind. The current airport observation (METAR) at Miyako already shows gusts of 35 kt and a crosswind of 31 kt, with a storm warning in effect. On 10/23 09:00–21:00 the European model shows gusts of 56.7–59 kt and the US model 70.8 kt, with crosswind up to 70.3 kt; eight of eight models say High, and there is a 100% chance of gusts over 49 kt. Strong wind lasts through 10/24 15:00–21:00, dropping to Low after 10/24 21:00. Overall disruption risk is High.

comment.en: The disruption risk is High, mainly due to strong winds/crosswinds and heavy rain. During 10/23 03–09 h local, airport observation (METAR) reported gusts of 35 kt and crosswind of 31 kt, while all 8 models say High. During 10/23 09–21 h local, there is a 100% chance of gusts over 49 kt, with the German model forecasting gusts and crosswinds up to 78.5 kt, and the Japanese model showing 63.6 mm of rain in 6 hours. High risk continues through 10/24 15–21 h local (5 of 8 models say High), dropping to Low after 10/24 21 h local.
